title: CFTC Leveraged-Money Nasdaq-versus-Dow Relative Flow and Book Economics

macro_program.name: external_market_event
macro_program.reason: The treatment is a causally delayed official regulatory positioning release, not broker execution, recovery or safety work.

research_height.transfer_path: official weekly leveraged-money relative positioning flow -> US30/US100 native signal and birth supply -> book-relative lifecycle value and stop quality -> whole-portfolio risk-or-lot research decision

central_question: When the latest causally available CFTC Traders in Financial Futures report shows leveraged-money net positioning shifting toward Nasdaq mini relative to DJIA x $5, does the current US100 book gain material and broad stressed lifecycle value and stop quality relative to the US30 book?

lenses: mechanism and causal boundary: reconstruct one threshold-free weekly change in Nasdaq-minus-Dow leveraged-money net share using only reports conservatively known before the portfolio day
transmission: compare US100-minus-US30 native signal and durable-birth supply under Nasdaq-shift and Dow-shift states without imputing absent opportunities
portfolio result and falsification: compare component-period-centered stressed-R and stop-rate book differences-in-differences with period, component and contribution breadth
research_bundle.common_boundary: Only the individual Nasdaq mini and DJIA x $5 futures-only TFF rows, one frozen causal availability schedule and the immutable fixed-0.01 CP2 portfolio population are used.

newly_identifying_evidence: The official CFTC Historical Special Announcements page supplies exact catch-up publication dates for the 2023 ION interruption and the 2025 appropriations lapse.

For all other reports, report date plus seven calendar days followed by a strict server-date inequality is deliberately later than the ordinary Friday release and stated one-or-two-day holiday delays.
Using individual contract codes 209742 and 124603 avoids the May 2023 consolidated e-micro composition change.

rejected_before_opening.reason: Unit 088 explicitly forbids those adjacent rescues and retains no seed.
Natural accumulation is required; Live polling, replay, cross-family execution and synthetic rows remain forbidden.
No new signal seed, dense order treatment, causal remaining-path checkpoint, complete binding counterfactual or decision-changing meta role is currently available.

frontier_selection.selection_reason: The exact official exception schedule removes the prior publication-timing blocker, while the treatment directly addresses the preserved US30/US100 economic asymmetry using a new weekly regulatory-positioning role rather than another price pair or clock.

why_now.current_bottleneck: US30 broadly protects US100 while US100 remains a positive lower-yield sleeve, yet no clean external state has justified a book-level risk or lot distinction. Unit 088's daily gold-yen state was valid but economically ambiguous.
connection_bridge: Unit 050 found one-way US30-to-US100 drawdown protection, and Unit 072 preserved US100 as positive but lower-yield rather than insurance-only.
Unit 076 found unstable price-dispersion book-relative value and forbids an adjacent dispersion regime rescue.
CFTC individual Nasdaq and Dow futures positioning maps directly to the two current books and could change a future whole-portfolio risk/lot decision only if the complete book-relative gate passes.
why_now.perspective_distance_from_recent: Unit 088 used a same-day tradable gold/yen sign state before 12:00. Unit 089 uses a conservatively lagged official weekly regulatory positioning flow, a relative US100-versus-US30 book mechanism, and an explicit publication-exception schedule.
why_now.same_program_continuation_justification: Program 2 is repeated only because a previously unavailable causal release role is now identifiable and directly resolves a different book-allocation question; no lower-value candidate in another program has a new decision-changing data role.
why_now.decision_if_nasdaq_shift_passes: Preserve current behavior and retain exactly one non-automatic future real-tick whole-portfolio question testing a bounded risk-or-lot tilt toward US100 under the same frozen state.
why_now.decision_if_dow_shift_passes: Preserve current behavior and retain exactly one non-automatic future real-tick whole-portfolio question testing the symmetric bounded risk-or-lot tilt toward US30 under the same frozen state.
why_now.decision_if_no_field_ambiguous_or_invali: Preserve unconditional book treatment, retain no CFTC seed and rotate away.

whole_map_recomparison.program_1: No unconsumed causal entry seed remains after Unit 085 was consumed by failed Unit 086.
whole_map_recomparison.program_2: Selected for a newly causal official positioning release role, not another price pair, event window, clock or threshold.
whole_map_recomparison.program_3: Priority, occupancy, pending reservation, handoff and latency roles remain closed or density-limited.
whole_map_recomparison.program_4: No newly observed previsible remaining-path checkpoint exists for a management decision.

whole_map_recomparison.after_close: Recompare Programs 1-5 and 7 and all heights. Do not automatically open another trader category, contract, lag, level, threshold, week, book, period or allocation variant.

legacy_boundary.distinction: Legacy CFTC work belonged to external-context early-exit management. Unit 089 selects no exit and tests all six current components through a two-book relative allocation diagnosis.

predeclaration_outcome_free_feasibility.method: Five official yearly TFF futures-only ZIP files were read transiently in memory. Only target positioning fields, report dates, CP2 SIZE_DAY/SIGNAL_DECIDED/birth timestamps and component identities were inspected; no persistent source artifact was created and no CP2 final value, planned risk, stressed-R or stop reason was read.
predeclaration_outcome_free_feasibility.selection_use: Density and causal feasibility only; no treatment direction, material threshold or verdict was selected from portfolio outcomes.

freeze_outputs: all five raw official ZIP byte streams
all three official HTML source snapshots
one normalized target-row CSV sorted by report date then contract code
one acquisition receipt with URL, byte, SHA-256, row, schema, exception and output checks

causal_availability_contract.ordinary_report_rule: For every report date not in the explicit exception table, set availability_anchor_date to report_date plus seven calendar days. A portfolio server date may use the report only when server_date is strictly greater than availability_anchor_date.
causal_availability_contract.reason: CFTC states that reports are generally released Friday at 15:30 Eastern using Tuesday data and that holidays may delay release by one or two days. The strict next-day-after-seven-days rule is intentionally conservative and removes same-day timezone ambiguity.
causal_availability_contract.exception_rule: For the documented interruption rows below, availability_anchor_date is the CFTC's exact replacement publication date. Again require portfolio server_date strictly greater than that date.
causal_availability_contract.target_revision_guard: If the acquired official special-announcement snapshot identifies a later correction to either individual target code within the study horizon that cannot be reconstructed as a release-time vintage, close invalid before outcomes.
causal_availability_contract.day_assignment: For each portfolio server date, select the latest chronological paired report whose availability anchor date is strictly earlier than the server date.

frozen_positioning_state.leveraged_money_net_share: (Lev_Money_Positions_Long_All - Lev_Money_Positions_Short_All) / Open_Interest_All for each target contract and report
frozen_positioning_state.relative_level: Nasdaq leveraged-money net share minus DJIA leveraged-money net share
frozen_positioning_state.relative_flow: current paired report relative_level minus the immediately preceding paired report relative_level
frozen_positioning_state.no_grid: No absolute level, percentile, z-score, magnitude threshold, smoothing, alternate week, trader-category or futures-and-options variant exists.

frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.ordering: Within each period concatenate pinned files and preserve stable source-file/source-row order for equal server timestamps.
frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.normal_day: Each unique SIZE_DAY server date is one normal portfolio day.
frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.native_signal: Each SIGNAL_DECIDED row is one observed native passed opportunity.
frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.birth: OPEN for RC16, RC4, Cross, Pressure and Return; PASSIVE_FILL for Passive.
frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.final: CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE paired by strict per-component alternation. Stressed P/L is value_b; planned_risk and DEAL_REASON are parsed from detail.
frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.stressed_r: value_b divided by positive planned_risk at final close.
frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.stop: One for DEAL_REASON_SL and zero for DEAL_REASON_EXPERT.
frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.centering: Subtract the all-state component-period mean stressed_r and stop rate from each lifecycle before state/book aggregation.
frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.supply_context: Report per-day US100-minus-US30 SIGNAL_DECIDED and durable-birth counts in each state. Supply is context only and cannot select a treatment.

fixed_primary_metrics.book_r_effect: For each book, mean centered stressed_r in NQ_SHIFT minus mean centered stressed_r in DJ_SHIFT.
fixed_primary_metrics.book_stop_effect: For each book, mean centered stop in NQ_SHIFT minus mean centered stop in DJ_SHIFT.
fixed_primary_metrics.relative_stop_did: US100 book_stop_effect minus US30 book_stop_effect; negative favors US100 under NQ_SHIFT.
fixed_primary_metrics.period_metrics: Repeat both differences-in-differences inside each of the four frozen periods.
fixed_primary_metrics.component_metrics: Report each component's NQ_SHIFT-minus-DJ_SHIFT centered R and stop effect without selecting a subgroup.

requirements: All declared project pins and all acquired official byte/hash pins pass.
Each target report date has exactly one FutOnly row for code 209742 and one for 124603 with positive open interest and finite position fields.
Target report dates and paired relative levels are unique and strictly increasing; every state after the first pair is finite.
The official special-announcement snapshot contains every frozen 2023 and 2025 exception mapping and no unidentified later correction to either target code in the horizon.
Lifecycle reconstruction yields exactly 2,233 pairs, including 2,027 CLOSE and 206 EXTERNAL_CLOSE finals, with prior component, period, book, stressed-net and stop anchors matching within 1e-9.
Exactly 1,051 SIZE_DAY dates and 2,429 SIGNAL_DECIDED rows reconstruct with zero duplicate or unmatched event.
At least 95 percent of normal days and lifecycles in every period map to a finite NQ_SHIFT or DJ_SHIFT state.
Each state has at least 40 normal days in every period, each period-book-state cell at least 40 lifecycles and each pooled component-state cell at least 40 lifecycles.

nasdaq_shift_relative_value: US100 book_r_effect is strictly positive and book_stop_effect strictly negative; US30 book_r_effect is strictly negative and book_stop_effect strictly positive.
Both relative directions hold in at least three of four periods.
Both US100 components have positive R and negative stop effects; at least three of four US30 components have negative R and positive stop effects.
No one period contributes more than 60 percent and no one component more than 45 percent of the absolute pooled relative-R numerator.
dow_shift_relative_value: US100 book_r_effect is strictly negative and book_stop_effect strictly positive; US30 book_r_effect is strictly positive and book_stop_effect strictly negative.
Both relative directions hold in at least three of four periods.
Both US100 components have negative R and positive stop effects; at least three of four US30 components have positive R and negative stop effects.
No one period contributes more than 60 percent and no one component more than 45 percent of the absolute pooled relative-R numerator.

requirements: Absolute pooled relative_r_did is less than 0.05R.
Absolute pooled relative_stop_did is less than 0.025.
Neither relative direction holds concordantly in more than two periods.
Neither US100 component pair nor three of four US30 components jointly support one complete direction.

fixed_verdict_rules.nasdaq_shift: PASS_CFTC_NASDAQ_SHIFT_RELATIVE_BOOK_VALUE_RETAIN_ONE_RISK_LOT_QUESTION when integrity and every Nasdaq-shift gate pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.dow_shift: PASS_CFTC_DOW_SHIFT_RELATIVE_BOOK_VALUE_RETAIN_ONE_RISK_LOT_QUESTION when integrity and every Dow-shift gate pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.no_field: NO_MATERIAL_CFTC_LEVERAGED_MONEY_RELATIVE_BOOK_FIELD when integrity passes and the complete strong-null rule triggers.
fixed_verdict_rules.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_CFTC_LEVERAGED_MONEY_RELATIVE_FLOW_NO_CANDIDATE when integrity passes and no preceding verdict applies.
fixed_verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_CFTC_RELEASE_OR_BOOK_RECONSTRUCTION_NO_VERDICT when any source, release, target, event, lifecycle, coverage or density integrity requirement fails.

decision_translation.directional_pass: Preserve current behavior and retain exactly one non-automatic future whole-portfolio real-tick bounded risk-or-lot treatment question in the selected book direction. The current exploratory evidence authorizes no implementation.
decision_translation.no_field_or_ambiguous: Preserve unconditional book treatment, retain no CFTC seed and rotate away.
decision_translation.invalid: Preserve the observation gap and rotate away without same-family repair after budget exhaustion.
